blocks.en: The Hille-Yosida Theorem
blocks.zh: Hille-Yosida 定理
blocks.label: subsec:hille-yosida-theorem

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In the preceding section, we showed that every strongly continuous semigroup has an infinitesimal generator and also how the semigroup can be used to solve initial-value problems. The most important question from the PDE point of view is how to recognize those operators which are infinitesimal generators of a $C_0$-semigroup. The Hille-Yosida theorem provides an answer to that question.
blocks.zh: 前一节说明了每个强连续半群都有无穷小生成元, 也说明了如何利用半群求解初值问题. 从 PDE 的观点来看, 最重要的问题是如何识别那些作为 $C_0$ 半群无穷小生成元的算子. Hille-Yosida 定理回答这一问题.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $A$ be an operator in the Banach space $X$. Then $A$ is the infinitesimal generator of a $C_0$-semigroup $T(t)$ satisfying $\|T(t)\|\leq M\exp(\omega t)$ if and only if the following two conditions hold:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{hyp:hille-yosida-dense-closed} $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is dense and $A$ is closed,\item\label{hyp:hille-yosida-resolvent-powers} Every real number $\lambda>\omega$ is in the resolvent set of $A$ and $\|R_\lambda(A)^n\|\leq M/(\lambda-\omega)^n$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为 Banach 空间 $X$ 中的算子. 则 $A$ 是满足 $\|T(t)\|\leq M\exp(\omega t)$ 的 $C_0$ 半群 $T(t)$ 的无穷小生成元, 当且仅当以下两个条件成立:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{hyp:hille-yosida-dense-closed} $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 稠密, 且 $A$ 为闭算子,\item\label{hyp:hille-yosida-resolvent-powers} 每个实数 $\lambda>\omega$ 都属于 $A$ 的预解集, 且对每个 $n\in\mathbb{N}$ 都有 $\|R_\lambda(A)^n\|\leq M/(\lambda-\omega)^n$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: thm:hille-yosida-generation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It will be clear from the proof below that actually every complex number with $\operatorname{Re}\lambda>\omega$ is in the resolvent set and that $\|R_\lambda(A)^n\|\leq M/(\operatorname{Re}\lambda-\omega)^n$.
blocks.zh: 由下面的证明可见, 实际上每个满足 $\operatorname{Re}\lambda>\omega$ 的复数都属于预解集, 且 $\|R_\lambda(A)^n\|\leq M/(\operatorname{Re}\lambda-\omega)^n$.

blocks.en: Let $A$ be the infinitesimal generator of a $C_0$-semigroup of bounded linear operators on $X$. Then $\exp(At)$, $t\geq0$ denotes the semigroup generated by $A$.
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为 $X$ 上有界线性算子 $C_0$ 半群的无穷小生成元. 则用 $\exp(At)$, $t\geq0$, 表示由 $A$ 生成的半群.
blocks.label: def:semigroup-exponential-notation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We also introduce the following convenient notation.
blocks.zh: 还引入以下方便的记号.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that a linear operator $A$ in $X$ is in $G(M,\omega)$ if it satisfies the hypotheses of Theorem~\ref{thm:hille-yosida-generation}.
blocks.zh: 若 $X$ 中线性算子 $A$ 满足 Theorem~\ref{thm:hille-yosida-generation} 的假设, 则称其属于 $G(M,\omega)$.
blocks.label: def:semigroup-generator-class

blocks.en: The Lumer-Phillips Theorem
blocks.zh: Lumer-Phillips 定理
blocks.label: subsec:lumer-phillips-theorem

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The conditions of the Hille-Yosida theorem are still not easy to verify in applications since they require bounds on all powers of the resolvent. However, the situation is much simpler if $M=1$: If $\|R_\lambda(A)\|\leq(\lambda-\omega)^{-1}$, then obviously $\|R_\lambda(A)^n\|\leq(\lambda-\omega)^{-n}$. Because of the importance of this case, we make the following definition.
blocks.zh: Hille-Yosida 定理的条件在应用中仍不易验证, 因为它们要求对预解算子的所有幂给出界. 不过, 当 $M=1$ 时情形简单得多: 若 $\|R_\lambda(A)\|\leq(\lambda-\omega)^{-1}$, 则显然 $\|R_\lambda(A)^n\|\leq(\lambda-\omega)^{-n}$. 鉴于这一情形的重要性, 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A $C_0$-semigroup $T(t)$ is called a \textbf{quasicontraction semigroup} if $\|T(t)\|\leq\exp(\omega t)$ for some $\omega$. It is called a \textbf{contraction semigroup} if $\|T(t)\|\leq1$.
blocks.zh: 若对某个 $\omega$ 有 $\|T(t)\|\leq\exp(\omega t)$, 则称 $C_0$ 半群 $T(t)$ 为\textbf{拟压缩半群}. 若 $\|T(t)\|\leq1$, 则称它为\textbf{压缩半群}.
blocks.label: def:quasicontraction-contraction-semigroup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It is obvious that if $A$ generates a quasicontraction semigroup, then $A-\omega I$ generates a contraction semigroup. Actually, every semigroup can be made into a quasicontraction semigroup.
blocks.zh: 显然, 若 $A$ 生成拟压缩半群, 则 $A-\omega I$ 生成压缩半群. 实际上, 每个半群都可以变为拟压缩半群.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: thm:semigroup-equivalent-quasicontraction-norm

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We omit the proof of this theorem; it can be found, e.g., in \cite{Pa}. In many applications, it is more profitable to seek an appropriate equivalent norm than to try to verify the assumptions of the Hille-Yosida theorem directly. A practical criterion for generators of quasicontraction semigroups is given by the following result, known as the Lumer-Phillips theorem.
blocks.zh: 略去该定理的证明; 例如可见 \cite{Pa}. 在许多应用中, 寻找适当的等价范数比直接验证 Hille-Yosida 定理的假设更有利. 以下称为 Lumer-Phillips 定理的结果, 给出拟压缩半群生成元的一个实用判据.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space and let $A$ be a linear operator in $H$ satisfying the following conditions:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{hyp:lumer-phillips-dense-domain} $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is dense.\item\label{hyp:lumer-phillips-quasidissipativity} $\operatorname{Re}(x,Ax)\leq\omega(x,x)$ for every $x\in\mathcal{D}(A)$.\item\label{hyp:lumer-phillips-surjectivity} There exists a $\lambda_0>\omega$ such that $A-\lambda_0I$ is onto.\end{enumerate}Then $A$ generates a quasicontraction semigroup and $\|\exp(At)\|\leq\exp(\omega t)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $H$ 为 Hilbert 空间, $A$ 为 $H$ 中满足以下条件的线性算子:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{hyp:lumer-phillips-dense-domain} $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 稠密.\item\label{hyp:lumer-phillips-quasidissipativity} 对每个 $x\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 都有 $\operatorname{Re}(x,Ax)\leq\omega(x,x)$.\item\label{hyp:lumer-phillips-surjectivity} 存在 $\lambda_0>\omega$, 使 $A-\lambda_0I$ 为满射.\end{enumerate}则 $A$ 生成拟压缩半群, 且 $\|\exp(At)\|\leq\exp(\omega t)$.
blocks.label: thm:lumer-phillips-generation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Any self-adjoint operator whose spectrum is bounded from above generates a quasicontraction semigroup. Any skew-adjoint operator generates a contraction semigroup.
blocks.zh: 任何谱有上界的自伴算子都生成拟压缩半群. 任何斜自伴算子都生成压缩半群.
blocks.label: ex:self-skew-adjoint-semigroup-generation

blocks.en: An operator in a Hilbert space which satisfies condition~\ref{hyp:lumer-phillips-quasidissipativity} of Theorem~\ref{thm:lumer-phillips-generation} is called \textbf{quasidissipative}; it is called \textbf{dissipative} if $\omega=0$. An operator which satisfies conditions~\ref{hyp:lumer-phillips-quasidissipativity} and~\ref{hyp:lumer-phillips-surjectivity} is called \textbf{quasi-m-dissipative}.
blocks.zh: Hilbert 空间中满足 Theorem~\ref{thm:lumer-phillips-generation} 的条件~\ref{hyp:lumer-phillips-quasidissipativity} 的算子称为\textbf{拟耗散的}; 若 $\omega=0$, 则称其为\textbf{耗散的}. 满足条件~\ref{hyp:lumer-phillips-quasidissipativity} 和~\ref{hyp:lumer-phillips-surjectivity} 的算子称为\textbf{拟 m 耗散的}.
blocks.label: def:quasidissipative-dissipative-quasi-m

blocks.en:
We shall use the Lumer-Phillips theorem. Since the domain of $\bm{A}$ includes $H^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$, it is clear that $\bm{A}$ is densely defined. Moreover, for $\bm{u}\in H^1$, an integration by parts yields\[\begin{aligned}
(\bm{u},\bm{A}\bm{u})&=\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}\bm{u}(\bm{x})\cdot\bm{A}^i(\bm{x})\dfrac{\partial\bm{u}}{\partial x_i}\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=-\dfrac{1}{2}\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}\bm{u}\cdot\dfrac{\partial\bm{A}^i}{\partial x_i}\bm{u}\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}.
\end{aligned}\]Hence the second condition of the Lumer-Phillips theorem holds for every $\bm{u}\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$, and we can take limits to show it holds for every $\bm{u}\in\mathcal{D}(\bm{A})$.
blocks.zh:
将使用 Lumer-Phillips 定理. 由于 $\bm{A}$ 的定义域包含 $H^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 显然 $\bm{A}$ 稠密定义. 此外, 对 $\bm{u}\in H^1$, 分部积分得到\[\begin{aligned}
(\bm{u},\bm{A}\bm{u})&=\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}\bm{u}(\bm{x})\cdot\bm{A}^i(\bm{x})\dfrac{\partial\bm{u}}{\partial x_i}\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=-\dfrac{1}{2}\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}\bm{u}\cdot\dfrac{\partial\bm{A}^i}{\partial x_i}\bm{u}\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}.
\end{aligned}\]因此, Lumer-Phillips 定理的第二个条件对每个 $\bm{u}\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 都成立; 通过取极限可证明, 它对每个 $\bm{u}\in\mathcal{D}(\bm{A})$ 也成立.

visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For $\epsilon>0$, there exists a mapping $Q_\epsilon$ from $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ into $H^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$ such that the following properties hold:\begin{enumerate}\item For every $\bm{f}\in L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$, $Q_\epsilon\bm{f}\to\bm{f}$ in $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ as $\epsilon\to0$.\item The operator $\bm{A}Q_\epsilon-Q_\epsilon\bm{A}$ can be extended to a bounded operator in $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$. Moreover, for any fixed $\bm{u}\in\mathcal{D}(\widetilde{\bm{A}})$, $\bm{A}Q_\epsilon\bm{u}-Q_\epsilon\widetilde{\bm{A}}\bm{u}\to0$ in $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 对 $\epsilon>0$, 存在从 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 到 $H^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 的映射 $Q_\epsilon$, 使以下性质成立:\begin{enumerate}\item 对每个 $\bm{f}\in L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 当 $\epsilon\to0$ 时, $Q_\epsilon\bm{f}\to\bm{f}$ 在 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中成立.\item 算子 $\bm{A}Q_\epsilon-Q_\epsilon\bm{A}$ 可延拓为 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中的有界算子. 此外, 对任意固定的 $\bm{u}\in\mathcal{D}(\widetilde{\bm{A}})$, 有 $\bm{A}Q_\epsilon\bm{u}-Q_\epsilon\widetilde{\bm{A}}\bm{u}\to0$ 在 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中成立.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: lem:friedrichs-commutator-approximation
